proposals.title: Pin Examiner fee + book algebra to published Kalshi formulas
proposals.measurement_kernel: Reconstruct YES/NO asks from bids-only book (ask_YES=1-best_NO_bid). Fee on fill: round_up(M*rate*C*P*(1-P)) with rate in {0.07 taker, 0 or 0.0175 maker, series overrides}. Joinable to Collector orderbook+trades; refuse completed-profit claims without fee channel.
proposals.dead_overlap: Hardens Q1-Q6 inherited fee model docs/tests only; does not retune Q6 allocator or Q7 paircheck.
proposals.cost_to_try: 4-8 person-hours; public fee PDF + one orderbook fixture; no paid data
proposals.why: Lowest-cost venue ground truth; every bakeoff is fee-blind without it.

proposals.title: Challenger kernel: binary A-S / Feil-Nendel settlement-aware quotes
proposals.measurement_kernel: Bernoulli variance sigma^2=p(1-p); reservation r=p_fair - q*gamma*p(1-p)*(T-t); running inventory penalty + terminal Phi=-gamma_T*q^2*p(1-p). Pre-settlement metrics: skew vs q, width vs p(1-p), inventory path. Clock-joinable on Collector L2.
proposals.dead_overlap: Not Q6 paired NFL allocator; not Q7 pair-cost filter. Partial concept overlap with Q2 inventory/completion (negative for profit max) — treat as new challenger line.
proposals.cost_to_try: 20-40 hours offline sim on non-NFL binary or single-game YES/NO; public tape; kits not required for intensity first pass
proposals.why: Clearest reconstructable LOB-PM theory; fair-game displacement if single-market inventory beats paired NFL under same capital.

proposals.title: Sportsbook fair + paired hedge + odds-staleness adverse gate
proposals.measurement_kernel: De-vig to p_fair; quote iff edge>=min_edge; on fill hedge opposite so YES+NO cost<1; adverse markout edge_at_quote vs edge_at_fill vs odds_age_sec; EDGE_LOST cancel. Polymarket venue mismatch — algebra only.
proposals.dead_overlap: High overlap with Q6/Q7 combined pair acquisition economics — do not silent-retune. Use as measurement/Adversary gate or post-Q7 external-odds arm. Author wallet P&L is not Astra evidence.
proposals.cost_to_try: 15-25 hours measurement-only markout join; optional paid odds API if Scout approves; full bot port deferred
proposals.why: Only OSS sports MM with honest adverse-selection autopsy; stress-tests queue/pair assumptions without inventing EV.

proposals.title: RFQ combo maker edge: fill vs independent-leg product vs resolution
proposals.measurement_kernel: Independent-leg price = product of per-leg 1-min TOB mids at fill minute; compare fill-model and fill-resolution; slice by price band, same-game vs decorrelated, leg count. Read-only crawl first.
proposals.dead_overlap: None with Q1-Q6 game-book allocator. Distinct RFQ structure; pin combo maker-fee overrides from fee schedule/changelog.
proposals.cost_to_try: 30-60 hours bounded crawl+Polars; needs read-only Kalshi API via Collector/Mechanic (not chat); Parquet disk
proposals.why: Strongest non-NFL displacement candidate but RFQ ops/credentials out of week-1 Deep Research scope; Scout+Collector first.

proposals.title: Adopt spencerfletcher measurement rails into Astra sim/collector
proposals.measurement_kernel: Exact Decimal fee with venue rounding; refuse quotes whose maker credit floors to zero; book freshness from content/transaction-time not WS ping; queue-attribution instrument vs assumed early queue (3300/10000).
proposals.dead_overlap: Critiques Q1 queue assumption and fee-table approximations; does not replace Q6. Live launcher out of scope (NO LIVE ORDERS).
proposals.cost_to_try: 12-20 hours port fee-floor + freshness + queue-attribution tests; no withheld production constants
proposals.why: Hardens incumbent evidence quality before shadow; cheap vs new strategy waves.
